name: motif_trial
description:
Read a Trial report. Reads the saved report of a Proposal's Trial: red flags, incomplete cases, named losses, stopped words with their causes and second-reading holds. It reads stored evidence and does not rerun the parser.
Command: proposal trial. Agent class: Read.
proposal: The Proposal ID.
job: Exact Trial job to resume or read.
report: Exact stored report to read.
detail: Report disclosure level.
section: Report section to read.
set: Review set to select.
outcome: Include only rows with this outcome.
flag: Include only rows with this Review flag.
filter: Filter full-detail rows.
word: Select one reported word.
case: Select one reported case.
trace: Read a trace for the selected word or case.
side: Select the before or after readings.
cursor: Continuation from the same report and filters.
limit: Maximum page items. Default 50.
page: Page of the retirement signature rows of a saved report. Default 1.
latest: Read the newest Trial job and its report identity when available.
Trial a Proposal. Measures a Proposal on a throwaway copy and records review evidence, always including declared gate word sets. Read named losses, incomplete cases and new second readings held for review before deciding what to do.
Command: trial. Agent class: Evaluate.
proposal: The exact canonical Proposal identity.
words: The explicit words to measure, or the configured Selection when omitted.
negative_words: Attested counterexamples that should not parse.
no_background: True runs any Baseline recapture this Trial needs in the foreground only: no Source index or Parsimony job is queued and no runner is woken, so nothing commits after the command returns.
no_base_sample: True measures exactly and leaves out every configured review word set, so the Trial is a working-set Trial that cannot stand in for a gate; it needs Words.
expect_loss: Words the author declares as intended losses before this Trial is queued.
touched: Adds to every attested word whose Baseline analysis uses an object the Proposal edits; needs .
Read Trial progress. Waits for a Trial job and reads its state. Read the stored review report after the Trial completes.
Command: trial --wait. Agent class: Evaluate.
job: The exact job identity returned when evidence was queued.
wait_seconds: The deadline for normal completion.
wait_terminal: Cancel the job at the deadline and wait for its execution to end.

action.description: Run, read or explicitly refresh a report.

words_file.description: Path to a UTF-8 word list.

negative_words.description: Attested counterexamples that should not parse.

expect_loss.description: Words the change intends to lose, frozen when the Trial is queued. They are reported in the saved gate and do not make it a loss; any other lost word does. A resumed Trial cannot change them.

touched.description: True adds to words every attested word whose Baseline analysis uses an allomorph, entry or sense the Proposal edits (matched by id, at most 500). Needs words or wordsFile; not with job.

no_base_sample.description: True measures exactly the words given in words or wordsFile and adds no review word set: a working-set Trial for a development loop, recorded as sample working-set. It is never a gate and is compared only with another working-set Trial over the same list. Needs words; not with negative_words, review_sets or job.

no_background.description: True keeps the Trial foreground only: any Baseline recapture runs inline and no Parsimony job is queued after the Trial commits, so nothing commits after the tool returns. Not with job.

wait_terminal.description: Cancel the job on timeout and wait for its execution to end.

job.description: Exact Trial job to resume or read.

latest.description: Read the newest Trial job and its report identity when available.

outcome.description: Include only rows with this outcome.

flag.description: Include only rows with this Review flag.

trace.description: Read a trace for the selected word or case.

side.description: Select the before or after readings.

cursor.description: Continuation from the same report and filters.

page.description: Page of the retirement signature rows of a saved report, filled to a byte bound. Default 1; see losses.retirementAttestation.pageCount.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
